verdict.rationale: RunAnywhere is an on-device AI SDK and CLI, and a buyer could reasonably ask whether such a platform offers event-triggered automation, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only developer building blocks: tool calling, streamed token events and download progress events. None of these is a documented way for a user to define rules that fire actions automatically on events. With no direct evidence of rule-based triggers, the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
